text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Asahi Hai F.S., and<n>the normally
calm Biwa Hayahide<n>seems nervous about
participating in<n>a big G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She vows to do her best and<n>incorporate what she
learns from this<n>race in her calculations.
